description: This file defines the OrderContentWrapper class, which implements ContentWrapper and provides functionality to retrieve and cache order content for display in the application's order module.

classes.name: OrderContentWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class for retrieving, caching, and rendering order content based on order data.

methods.name: makeOrderContentWrapper
methods.description: Factory method to create an OrderContentWrapper instance for a given order and request.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the order content as a StringWrapper for specified content type and encoder.

methods.name: getOrderContentAsText (static, with request parameter)
methods.description: Retrieves the order content as text based on the request context, order, content type, and encoder.

methods.name: getOrderContentAsText (static, with specific parameters)
methods.description: Retrieves the order content as text with explicit locale, dispatcher, and other parameters.

methods.name: getOrderContentAsText (main static method)
methods.description: Core method that retrieves and caches the order content, constructs cache keys, and fetches content from the database.

methods.name: getOrderContentAsText (overloaded with additional parameters)
methods.description: Helper method that queries the database for the order content and renders it into outWriter, optionally caching the result.
